originalTitle: Was There Any Sign Coherent Stock Would Run?

content:
Coherent (COHR) stock returned 135.4% in the twelve months to October 12, 2026, against 17.3% for the S&P 500. Sales growth accelerated over those months, and management credits demand from AI data centers. Investors could have anticipated this run only if Coherent’s sales and profit metrics were already improving in reports filed before October 2025. So when did the improvement first show up?

Coherent’s Jump In Revenue Was Filed In 2024

The turning point appeared in the report Coherent filed on November 6, 2024, for its fiscal first quarter of 2025. Revenue in that quarter climbed 28.0% from a year earlier. This marked a sharp acceleration from the 9.1% growth reported in the previous quarter, filed in August 2024.

During an earnings call that same day, management noted that the company’s non-GAAP gross margin had widened from the prior quarter. So faster sales and a wider margin were both public knowledge about eleven months before October 2025.

Coherent’s Margin Widened, Then Its Sales Growth Slowed

Coherent kept its operating margin above its 2024 level in every quarter filed in 2025, but its sales growth lost momentum. On a February 5, 2025 call, management stated that widening the gross margin would be a strategic focus. The operating margin reached 10.1% in the report filed in February 2025, up from 5.9% in the quarter filed in August 2024.

A Zacks preview published on May 5, 2025, noted that Coherent’s sales were expected to have benefited from rising demand for transceivers, which are components the company supplies for data center networks. Coherent was also reducing its leverage. On an August 13, 2025 call, management reported the company had cut its debt leverage ratio to 2 times from 2.5 times.

Sales growth was fading, however. Revenue grew 23.9% in the quarter filed in May 2025 and 16.4% in the report filed that August, which was the final disclosure before October 2025. Coherent’s operating margin in that same August report had slipped back to 9.5%.

By Fall 2025 You Paid Double For Coherent

Coherent stock returned 120.7% in the six months before October 9, 2025, the first day of the twelve months measured here. Investors acting on those reports that October were therefore buying a stock that had already more than doubled. Coherent was not the only stock experiencing a run. Lumentum returned 523.1% in the twelve months to October 12, 2026.

Coherent’s data center business expanded significantly after that point. Its Datacenter & Communications segment brought in $5.3 billion in fiscal 2026, an increase from $3.8 billion the year before. That fiscal 2026 figure accounts for most of the $7.1 billion Coherent sold during the year.

Are Coherent’s Orders And Revenue Still Climbing?

The latest figures indicate they are. Revenue growth reached 17.3% in the fiscal first quarter of 2026 and 17.5% in the second. Growth then accelerated to 20.5% in the third quarter and 33.7% in the fourth.

Management guided to revenue of $2.2 billion to $2.4 billion for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, compared to $2.05 billion in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026. On an August 12, 2026 call, management also noted that demand drove another quarter of record bookings and that fiscal 2027 is basically booked out. Profit has kept pace, with the operating margin over the latest twelve months reaching 12.7%, against 9.2% a year earlier.

The stock has not followed this upward trajectory lately. Coherent shares are down 6.5% over the past six months, while the S&P 500 is up 14.0%. First-quarter revenue will be the number to watch in Coherent’s next report. A figure inside the guidance range would mean sales are still climbing, and a result below the fourth quarter’s $2.05 billion would show they have stopped.

chineseTitle: 有任何迹象表明相干股票会上涨吗？
chineseSummary: 截至 2026 年 10 月 12 日的 12 个月内，相干公司 (COHR) 的股票回报率为 135.4%，而标准普尔 500 指数的回报率为 17.3%。这几个月销售增长加速，管理信贷需求来自人工智能数据中心。只有在 2025 年 10 月之前提交的报告中相干公司的销售和利润指标已经有所改善的情况下，投资者才能预期到这一轮上涨。那么这种改善是什么时候首次出现的。
chineseContent:
截至 2026 年 10 月 12 日的 12 个月内，相干公司 (COHR) 的股票回报率为 135.4%，而标准普尔 500 指数的回报率为 17.3%。这几个月销售增长加速，管理信贷需求来自人工智能数据中心。只有在 2025 年 10 月之前提交的报告中相干公司的销售和利润指标已经有所改善的情况下，投资者才能预期到这一轮上涨。那么这种改善是什么时候首次出现的呢？

相干公司 2024 年收入大幅增长

这一转折点出现在相干公司于 2024 年 11 月 6 日提交的 2025 财年第一季度报告中。该季度收入同比增长 28.0%。这标志着 2024 年 8 月提交的上一季度 9.1% 的增长大幅加速。

在当天的财报电话会议上，管理层指出，该公司的非公认会计准则毛利率较上一季度有所扩大。因此，在 2025 年 10 月之前大约 11 个月，更快的销售和更高的利润率就已经是众所周知的了。

相干公司的利润率扩大，但销售额增长放缓

相干公司在 2025 年提交的每个季度的营业利润率均保持在 2024 年水平之上，但其销售增长失去了动力。在 2025 年 2 月 5 日的电话会议上，管理层表示扩大毛利率将是战略重点。 2025 年 2 月提交的报告中，营业利润率达到 10.1%，高于 2024 年 8 月提交的季度的 5.9%。

Zacks 于 2025 年 5 月 5 日发布的预览指出，相干公司的销售预计将受益于收发器需求的增长，收发器是该公司为数据中心网络提供的组件。相干公司还降低了其杠杆率。在 2025 年 8 月 13 日的电话会议上，管理层报告称，该公司已将债务杠杆率从 2.5 倍削减至 2 倍。

然而，销售增长正在放缓。 2025 年 5 月提交的季度收入增长了 23.9%，8 月提交的报告（2025 年 10 月之前的最终披露）收入增长了 16.4%。同一份 8 月报告中，相干公司的营业利润率已回落至 9.5%。

到 2025 年秋季，您为相干公司支付了双倍费用

相干股票在 2025 年 10 月 9 日（此处衡量的 12 个月的第一天）之前的 6 个月内回报率为 120.7%。因此，根据 10 月份的报告采取行动的投资者买入了一只已经上涨了一倍多的股票。相干公司并不是唯一一只经历挤兑的股票。截至 2026 年 10 月 12 日的 12 个月内，Lumentum 的回报率为 523.1%。

此后，相干公司的数据中心业务大幅扩张。其数据中心和通信部门在 2026 财年实现收入 53 亿美元，高于上一年的 38 亿美元。 2026 财年的这一数字占相干公司全年 71 亿美元销售额的大部分。

相干公司的订单和收入还在攀升吗？

最新数据表明确实如此。 2026 财年第一季度收入增长 17.3%，第二季度收入增长 17.5%。第三季度增速加快至 20.5%，第四季度增速加快至 33.7%。

管理层预计 2027 财年第一季度的收入为 22 亿至 24 亿美元，而 2026 财年第四季度的收入为 20.5 亿美元。在 2026 年 8 月 12 日的电话会议上，管理层还指出，需求推动了又一个季度的预订量创纪录，2027 财年基本上已经预订一空。利润保持同步增长，最近 12 个月的营业利润率达到 12.7%，而去年同期为 9.2%。

该股最近并未遵循这一上涨轨迹。过去 6 个月，相干公司股价下跌 6.5%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨 14.0%。第一季度收入将是相干公司下一份报告中值得关注的数字。如果数字处于指导范围内，则意味着销售额仍在攀升，而低于第四季度 20.5 亿美元的结果则表明销售额已经停止增长。

现在您对 COHR 有了更多的了解。这就是我们的目的：让您在投资之前了解情况。然而，押注单一股票有其自身的风险。
